 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Medhi
 Order

31.03.2023 Heard Shri F.Z. Mazumder, learned counsel for the petitioner, who is aggrieved by the inaction on the part of the authorities to act on a complaint lodged by the petitioner involving the Food Safety Standard Act.

It is the case of the petitioner that he had detected some foreign particles in a 20 Litre jar of Bisleri mineral water which was accordingly brought to the notice of the authorities by filing the aforesaid complaint as per Section 40 of the Act.
It is the case of the petitioner that the jar was sent to the Food Analyst for examination and in the same examination, a Report was issued confirming the allegation of the petitioner.
However, the said report was kept in cold storage and not acted upon for almost a year.
Issue notice, returnable by 4 (four) weeks.

Page No.# 3/3 Ms. M. Barman, learned State Counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 1 & 3 whereas Shri M. Bhuyan, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos.
2 & 4.
Let extra copies of the writ petition be served upon the learned counsel for the respondents by Monday, i.e., 03.04.2023.

Additionally as prayed for, the petitioner is at liberty to serve dasti upon the respondent no. 5.
Needless to state that such dasti is required to be routed through the Registry of this Court and the notice accompanying the dasti service is to reflect the next date fixed which is on 28.04.2023.
Prior to the next date, the petitioner is required to file an affidavit in proof of such dasti service.
Registry is also directed to reflect the name of Standing Counsel, Health in the cause list.
Pendency shall not be a bar to proceed further with the Report of the analyst.
